I routed this as PRD_DELIVERY, with one PRD and three worktrees. I read the fixture and the two plugin references but ran none of the plugin's delivery commands, so nothing was previewed or written.

**Context.** I used only `domain:backend-service`, `domain:frontend-shell` and `repo:backend`, `repo:frontend`, `repo:governance`. The fixture's own map and registry only know `runtime-core`, and they list `repos/module`, which is outside the allowed context. I did not use `repo:module`.

**Solution choice.** `solution:one-prd-three-worktrees` matches how the skill splits work: one PRD owner, with separate backend, frontend and governance worktrees that each keep their own runtime receipt and implementation evidence. The alternative, `solution:linked-prds-per-repository`, was not chosen.

**Ownership.** Each repository keeps its own fact:
- `fact:backend-api-contract` belongs to `domain:backend-service`.
- `fact:frontend-integration-contract` belongs to `domain:frontend-shell`.

Governance stays the authority for accepted knowledge. I would write nothing under `repos/backend/docs/project-lifecycle/project-map.json` or `repos/frontend/docs/project-lifecycle/project-map.json`, and I read no archive.

**Gates.** All required human gates are covered by granted approvals, so I did not stop:
- `CONFLICT_RESOLUTION` is covered by `approval:conflict-resolution`.
- `MULTI_REPOSITORY_ACCEPTANCE` is covered by `approval:multi-repository-acceptance`.

**Files I would write.** All paths are under `docs/project-lifecycle/`:
- `delivery/layout.json`, because the fixture has no delivery tree yet.
- The PRD pair for `prd-cross-repo`: `delivery/prds/prd-cross-repo/prd-cross-repo-en.md` and its Chinese mirror `prd-cross-repo.md`.
- Generated INDEX files from `materialize-delivery-asset --update-indexes`. I left them out of the JSON because the command generates them and their exact paths aren't known from my reading. They would not be written by hand.

The PRD would record `knowledge_baseline` `baseline:fixture-1`, the declared facts, and the three worktree scopes. It would use `creation_origin` `explicit_user`, since the brief requests it, and it would not claim any acceptance.

**Gap.** `unknown:independent-merge-order` is still open, so the PRD must carry it forward and not guess an order.
